title: ListingGood MCP
description: ListingGood — get recommended by Amazon's AI. A hosted MCP server that makes your Amazon listings readable and recommendable by Amazon's AI shopping agents. Tools: AI recommendation-readiness check, compliance pre-check, deep compliance scan, POA appeal writer, negative-review analyzer, one-sentence listing builder, and multi-marketplace listing generator. Pay-as-you-go with ListingGood stars (free tier included, new users get 10 stars).
